senses.sense_definition: A musical performance or love song sung or played directly to someone, especially outdoors under a window at night.

examples.text: He stood beneath her bedroom window and sang a romantic <w>serenade</w>.
She was deeply touched when he offered a midnight <w>serenade</w> outside her balcony.

senses.sense_definition: An instrumental classical musical composition in several movements, light in character.

examples.text: The orchestra performed an elegant string <w>serenade</w> by Mozart during the evening concert.
The composer wrote a lovely chamber <w>serenade</w> for winds and strings.

senses.sense_definition: To sing or play a piece of music to someone, usually as a romantic or complimentary gesture.

examples.text: The musician decided to <w>serenade</w> her with an acoustic guitar.
Guests gathered in the courtyard while the band began to <w>serenade</w> the newlyweds.
